verdict.rationale: Buzz is a team chat platform, so letting developers register custom slash commands is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no slash-command registration. It shows only adjacent mechanisms: agents triggered by @mentions through the buzz-acp harness, CLI commands, persona-pack skills, and the NIP-29 open protocol. None of these is a user-invokable slash command registered from the message box.

support.subject: As a developer, I can register custom slash commands that users invoke from the message box
